source: Worked by hand from PLAN.md sections 4, 5 and 10 by an agent at the user's instruction, before comparing with the code. Cross-checked by core/routing/tests/test_expected_values_independent.py, which recomputes every value from the PLAN.md definitions with brute-force path enumeration, Edmonds-Karp, an exhaustive min cut and exact fractions. That test is by the same author, so A should still check the numbers.

bd_failed_F1.description: Diamond with BD down, F1 (P0, 15). Pre-placement max flow is 10 over A-C-D.

path_limit_F1.description: Healthy diamond, max_paths 1, F1 (15). Max flow is 20, so the bound is 15. No cut under PATH_LIMIT.

blocking.description: The blocking example of expected_cases.json. Bound 3 (max flow), delivered 2, cut = the minimum cut {S,A}|{C,E,T}.
blocking.explanation: X (P0, 3 Mbps): path S-C-A-T limited by L1 (saturated). Placed 1 Mbps to S-C-A-T (latency 4 ms). Placed 1 Mbps to S-A-C-E-T (latency 10 ms). 1 Mbps unserved, of which 1 Mbps could have been routed (heuristic or path limit).

healthy_F2.description: Healthy diamond, F1 (P0, 15) then F2 (P2, 10). F2 sees 5 free on A-C-D and gets it. Reachable set is {A}.
